results.statement: With atm-core's PORT-010 path exclusions removed, sc-lint's PORT-010 rule must report no finding on atm-core that the verdict table in sc-lint issue #786 classifies as a false positive or deliberate exception.
results.quote:
atm-core can remove its PORT-010 exclusions and get zero false alarms, while real Windows gaps are still reported.
Definition question (team-lead, 2026-10-30): "false alarm = a finding #786's table classifies as false positive or deliberate exception" Rand: "yes"
results.context: Phase M planning; Rand approved the sentence and answered 'yes' to the definition question, relayed by team-lead 2026-10-30
results.deterministic_check: #786 per-path repro on atm-core with every PORT-010 exclusion removed reports no finding the #786 table classifies as false positive or deliberate exception.
